Community testing: ROCKNIX

RGDS: gameplay and controls reported working with LibMali. In Panfrost mode, gameplay works but normal controls were not received. H700 with Panfrost was reported working. Device and firmware differences still need investigation.

Bring your game

Install Residual.zip with PortMaster, then copy residual.jar from your GOG Windows 1.4.1 installation into the installed residual folder. On muOS use <SD card>/ports/residual/residual.jar. See the README for the supported checksum and offline-installer instructions. Requires 64-bit ARM firmware; PortMaster provides Java 17 and Westonpack.

Install the port

  1. Update PortMaster. Copy residual.zip into its autoinstall/ folder and open PortMaster.
  2. Allow PortMaster to download Java 17 and Westonpack. An internet connection is needed if these runtimes are not installed.
  3. Copy the owned game files into residual/ as described above. Launch Residual from your ports menu.
